context: A retail bank needs a traceable loan application workflow covering identity, affordability, automated decisions, manual review, consent, security, and status communication.

requirements.text: Applicants must be able to create and submit a personal loan application online.
The bank must verify applicant identity against approved KYC documents before assessment.
Applicants must provide verifiable income evidence covering at least the previous three months.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what income evidence is required.

requirements.text: The system must obtain the applicant's consent before requesting a credit bureau report.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about consent for external credit data.

requirements.text: Applications with a debt-to-income ratio above 50 percent must not be auto-approved.
Borderline applications must be assigned to a credit officer for manual review.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how uncertain decisions are handled.
requirements.condition: to credit officer for manual review

requirements.text: Applicants should be able to view the current status and outstanding documents for their application.
A rejected applicant must receive the principal reason category without exposing internal fraud rules.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what information is provided after rejection.

requirements.text: Loan documents and identity data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about protection of sensitive data.

requirements.text: Every automated and manual lending decision must be recorded with timestamp, policy version, and decision maker.
requirements.condition: for every automated and manual decision
